scope: Zeros, poles, kernels and reducibility walls of the normalized spherical SL(2,R) simple-root operator, followed by the exact consequence for regular imaginary D7 charge.

normalized_divisor.positive_wall_kernel: at z=2r+1, every even mode with |n|>=r+1 is killed while |n|<=r survives
normalized_divisor.negative_wall_pole: at z=-(2r+1), every even mode with |n|>=r+1 has a simple normalized pole
normalized_divisor.inverse_pairing: the positive-wall kernel and negative-wall pole are exchanged by z maps to -z
normalized_divisor.zero_parameter: z=0 is regular and a_n(0)=1 for every n

reducibility.rank_one_spherical_principal_series: reducible exactly at nonzero odd integral z in this normalization
reducibility.positive_odd_structure: the normalized operator has the explicit high-even-mode kernel
reducibility.negative_odd_structure: the inverse meromorphic family has the corresponding pole and quotient structure
reducibility.imaginary_axis: no zero, pole or kernel for z in iR
reducibility.regular_imaginary_d7: no simple-root reducibility hyperplane is met and the Weyl stabilizer is trivial
reducibility.d7_consequence: the supplied regular imaginary spherical minimal principal series is irreducible and all normalized simple operators are unitary isomorphisms

normalization_boundary.raw_spherical_divisor: K1327's nonpositive-even poles and negative-odd zeros belong to m(z)
normalization_boundary.normalized_operator_divisor: the odd K-type walls above are the operator-mode divisor after division by m(z)
normalization_boundary.warning: a scalar c-function zero or pole is not by itself an operator kernel or reducibility statement

claim_ceiling: The trivial-M rank-one reducibility walls and their complete even-mode kernels are explicit, and the supplied regular imaginary D7 charge meets none of them. Nonspherical inducing data and physical GU constraints are outside this result.
